name: Stiiizy AIO | Hardcore OG
description:
2G All-In-One THC Vape
More STIIIZY. One device. STIIIZY 2G All-In-One is ideal for those who want simplicity, less setup, less switching pods in between. Featuring a button-activated design, and a wide lineup of strain selection, this all-in-one thc pen delivers the STIIIZY experience in a higher capacity 2 gram format.

Available Original THC Strains for the new 2G AIO:
Sativa
Blue Dream
Strawberry Cough
Sour Tangie
Premium Jack
Sour Diesel
Orange Sunset
Super Lemon Haze
Magic Melon
Hybrid
Apple Fritter
Gelato
Pineapple Express
GDP
Do Si Dos
Strawnana
Birthday Cake
Blue Burst
Pineapple Runtz
Pink Acai
Indica
SFV OG
Skywalker OG
Biscotti
Hardcore OG
OG Kush
Purple Punch
King Louis XIII
Watermelon Z
White Raspberry
Functionality
The 2G AIO is innovating your experience designed for control, consistency, and ease of use.

What sets it apart:

Button activation
USB-C charging
Preheat functions
Balanced airflow
Offered in 2 Gram
